## Schemas

> 复合 JSON flag 字段速查（只列顶层 + 一层嵌套）。深层结构看下方 `## Examples`，或用 `--print-schema` 读完整 JSON Schema（用法见 SKILL.md「公共 flag 速查」与「Agent 使用提示」）。

### `+pivot-create` `--properties` / `+pivot-update` `--properties`

_创建/更新的透视表属性_

**顶层字段**：
- `range` (string?) — 放置透视表的左上角单元格 A1 地址（例如：'F1'）（仅 create 时有效） — ⚠️ 已拎为独立 flag `--range`，请勿在此 JSON 内重复填写（同名以独立 flag 为准）
- `source` (string?) — 源数据区域地址，格式为 'SheetName!StartCell:EndCell'（例如：'Sheet1!A1:D100'） — ⚠️ 已拎为独立 flag `--source`，请勿在此 JSON 内重复填写（同名以独立 flag 为准）
- `rows` (array<object>?) — 纵向分组字段（行字段） each: { field: string, display_name?: string, sort?: object, filter?: object, condition_filter?: object, …共 6 项 }
- `columns` (array<object>?) — 横向分组字段（列字段） each: { field: string, display_name?: string, sort?: object, filter?: object, condition_filter?: object, …共 6 项 }
- `filters` (array<object>?) — 筛选区域字段（页字段） each: { field: string, display_name?: string, filter?: object, condition_filter?: object, group?: object }
- `values` (array<object>?) — 要汇总的字段（至少需要 1 个） each: { field: string, display_name?: string, summarize_by?: enum, show_data_as?: enum, base_field?: string }
- `auto_fit_col` (boolean?) — 是否自动调整列宽以适应内容
- `show_row_grand_total` (boolean?) — 是否显示行总计（默认 true）
- `show_col_grand_total` (boolean?) — 是否显示列总计（默认 true）
- `show_subtotals` (boolean?) — 是否显示分类小计（默认 true，应用于所有字段）
- `repeat_row_labels` (boolean?) — 是否显示重复项标签
- `calculated_fields` (array<object>?) — 计算字段列表 each: { name: string, formula: string, summarize_by?: enum }
- `collapse` (object?) — 行字段展开/折叠状态：字段名 -> 要折叠的项目列表

## Examples

公共四件套：所有 shortcut 顶部排列 `--url` / `--spreadsheet-token` / `--sheet-id` / `--sheet-name`，其中 `--sheet-id` / `--sheet-name` 在 `+pivot-update` / `+pivot-delete` / `+pivot-list` 上是公共四件套语义（定位透视表所在 sheet，XOR 必传一个）。

**`+pivot-create` 例外**：placement 选择器用 `--target-sheet-id` / `--target-sheet-name`（至多一个、都可省略；省略时后端自动新建子表，推荐）。数据源 sheet 写在 `--source` 的 `'SheetName'!Range` 里。

### `+pivot-list`

```bash
lark-cli sheets +pivot-list --url "..." --sheet-id "$SID"
```

> **返回值含 `info`（展开后的占用区域与状态）**：每个透视表对象除 `position` / `snapshot` 外，还返回 `info`，标明它在 sheet 上的平铺区域与状态——`info.page_range`（筛选/分页区 A1）、`info.content_range`（主体数据区 A1）、`info.span_range`（空表合并区 A1）、`info.error_state`（错误状态，如 `None`/`Cover`/`Shrink`/`Loading`）、`info.is_empty` / `info.is_hidden`、`info.row`/`info.col`（锚点）等。
> **用途 1（判断改值还是改配置）**：当用户描述某个单元格要改动时，先 `+pivot-list` 拿到 `info`，判断该单元格是否落在 `page_range` / `content_range` 内——**落在区域内 = 属于透视表，应走 `+pivot-update` 改配置**（透视表单元格不能直接 `+cells-set` 改值）；**落在区域外 = 普通单元格，正常 `+cells-set` 改值**。
> **用途 2（创建后校验覆盖）**：建完后轮询 `info.loaded/error_state`；`Loading` / `ServiceCalcLoading` 继续等待，`Cover` / `Shrink` 等终态错误才表示冲突。成功后用 `content_range/page_range` 核对真实占用区域与原数据边界。

### `+pivot-create`

> 数据源 `--source` 必须从表头行开始；空行 / 汇总行会被当作数据参与聚合，需提前用 `+csv-get` 确认起止边界。`--source` 和 `--range` 是独立 flag（不要再放 `--properties`）；`rows` / `columns` / `values` 等数组字段走 `--properties`。
>
> **先理清 `+pivot-create` 上 4 个位置类入参（语义不同，别混）**：
> - `--source`（**必填**）：**源数据**区域，须自带 `Sheet!` 前缀（如 `'Sheet1'!A1:D100`，sheet 名按 A1 标准单引号包裹）。源 sheet 的名字在 `--source` 字符串里，**不**通过单独 flag 传。
> - `--target-sheet-id` / `--target-sheet-name`：**透视表的落点 sheet**（即产物放哪张子表）。两个互斥（最多传一个），都不传时后端自动新建子表存放产物（强烈推荐）。
> - `--target-position`（可选，默认 `A1`）与 `--range`（可选）都映射到 `properties.range`，表达同一落点；不要同时给两个非默认值。
>
> **落点 3 种策略（互斥，选其一）**：
> 1. **默认（强烈推荐）**：`--target-sheet-id` / `--target-sheet-name` / `--target-position` / `--range` **全都不传** → 服务端**自动新建子表**存放产物，绝不碰任何已有数据。
> 2. **放进指定的已有子表**：传 `--target-sheet-id <落点子表 id>`（或 `--target-sheet-name`），可选 `--target-position <子表内起点 cell>`。⚠️ **若落点子表就是源数据所在的 sheet**，必须配 `--target-position` 或 `--range` 指向源数据范围**之外**的位置，否则产物默认从 A1 起会盖在源数据上。
> 3. **`--range`**：跟策略 2 等价（同样需要 `--target-sheet-id` / `--target-sheet-name` 指定落点子表，不然落到自动新建子表），只是改用 `--range` 表达同一落点（与 `--target-position` 同一 wire 字段）。同样的覆盖风险，同样需要避开源数据范围。
>
> 一般用策略 1（默认新建子表）即可，零覆盖风险，无需任何 `--target-*` / `--range` flag。

```bash
# 策略 1（强烈推荐）：不传任何落点 flag → 后端自动新建子表，零覆盖风险
lark-cli sheets +pivot-create --url "..." \
  --source "'Sheet1'!A1:D100" --properties @pivot.json

# 策略 2：落进指定的已有目标子表（注意目标 sheet ≠ 源 sheet，否则要配 --target-position 避开源数据）
lark-cli sheets +pivot-create --url "..." \
  --source "'Sheet1'!A1:D100" --target-sheet-id "$DEST_SID" --target-position "A1" --properties @pivot.json
```

### `+pivot-update`

> 不允许改落点 range；更新配置前先 `+pivot-list --sheet-id/--sheet-name <落点表> --pivot-table-id <id>` 回读完整 snapshot，再 patch rows / columns / values / filters。需要切换数据源时，可在 `--properties` 中提供新的 `source`。

### `+pivot-delete`

```bash
lark-cli sheets +pivot-delete --url "..." --sheet-id "$SHEET_ID" --pivot-table-id "$PIVOT_TABLE_ID" --yes
```

### Validate / DryRun / Execute 约束

- `Validate`：`--url` / `--spreadsheet-token` XOR 必填；update/delete/list 的 `--sheet-id` / `--sheet-name` XOR 必填；create 的 target selector 至多一个、可都省略；`--source` 与合法 `--properties` 必填；delete 强制 `--yes` 或 `--dry-run`。schema 校验类型与枚举，但允许创建空壳配置，业务完整性须靠创建后 list/data 验证。
- `DryRun`：输出将发送的 pivot 请求模板和本地 placement_warning；不联网、不预估实际展开尺寸。
- `Execute`：写后不自动回读；create/update 后必须按落点 sheet + pivot id 轮询 `+pivot-list` 到 loaded，核 error_state/content_range 与数据；delete 后 list 确认目标不存在。

> ⚠️ pivot 输出包含总计 / 小计行；后续 chart 引用 pivot 时，`snapshot.data.refs` 必须排除这些行（见 `references/lark-sheets-chart.md` 的「⚠️ chart 数据源引用 pivot 时必须排除总计行」段）。

DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST(2) | 明细的 `suggestContent` 原文（已是"描述建议N：\n..."格式） | 最后 | 6. 模块内按 sort 升序排列文案 → 即 **NO_DATA 最前 → NO_FILL 按字段配置顺序 → DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST 最后**。 7. 模块输出：`{moduleCode, moduleName, diagnoseList, diagnoseNum}`（`diagnoseNum` = 诊断条数）；`diagnoseList` 为空则不输出该模块。 --- ## 2. 仅分数接口 供"只问分数不问报告"的场景： | 情况 | 返回 score | |---|---| | 无评分记录 | -1 | | 最新记录 `runStatus == 0`（计算中） | -2 | | 计算完成 | 实际总分 | 同时按 `scoreList` 区间（左闭右开）取 `title` + `describe` 返回；另带 `runStatus` / `reportStatus` / `reportId` / `scoreTime`。 --- ## 3. 用户面向交付：HTML 报告（唯一交付格式） **最终只向用户交付 1 份 HTML 报告**（写入 `简历诊断报告_.html` 后用 `present_files` 展示）。**不渲染 markdown/文本版报告**；中间 JSON（filled/finalized/suggestions/gpt_score/report）不落盘，仅最终 HTML 报告文件落盘。报告只含返回的三部分：`score`、`beatPercent`、`reportDetails`（各模块诊断列表）。禁止添加六维得分明细、分数区间评价（title/describe 属于"仅分数接口"，不属于本报告）、综合评价等任何接口外信息（扩展内容见第 4 节）。 **渲染方式（模板驱动，禁止手写布局逻辑）**： 1. `Read` 读取模板：`assets/diagnose-report-template.html`（**静态占位符模板**，无任何脚本）。 2. 把 report.json 数据填入模板占位符，其余模板代码一字不改，得到**完整 HTML 报告内容**。 3. 将完整 HTML 写入最终报告文件（文件名如 `简历诊断报告_.html`），调用 `present_files` 交付给用户。 **占位符清单**： | 占位符 | 数据来源 | 填充规则 | |---|---|---| | `{{RESUME_ID}}` | `report.resumeId` | 原样注入 | | `{{GENERATED_AT}}` | 当前日期 | `yyyy-MM-dd` | | `{{SCORE}}` | `report.score` | 有效（≥0）填数字；`-1`/`-2`/缺失填 `—` | | `{{SCORE_RING_OFFSET}}` | `report.score` | `326.73 × (1 − score / 100)`，保留 2 位小数；无效填 `326.73` | | `{{SCORE_RING_COLOR}}` | `report.score` | `score ≥ 70` → `#10b981`；`40 ≤ score < 70` → `#3b6ef6`；`score < 40` → `#f59e0b`；无效 → `#3b6ef6` | | `{{BEAT_TEXT}}` | `report.beatPercent` | 有值 → `击败了 {beatPercent} 的求职者`；无值 → `报告生成完成` | | `{{BEAT_TITLE}}` | `report.beatPercent` | 有值 → `你的简历整体表现`；无值 → `分数区间暂无可对比数据` | | `{{MODULE_ROWS}}` | `report.reportDetails` | 按模板注释结构逐模块生成；数组为空 → `
暂无诊断明细
` | **渲染纪律**： 1. `score` / `beatPercent` / `reportDetails` 三部分与接口一致；**不展示**六维得分明细、分数区间评价、综合评价。 2. `diagnoseList` 文案**逐条原样注入**，不得改写模板话术（`【…】可以为你加分哦，去完善` / `【…】是简历中的重要信息，请完善` / `描述建议N：…`）；描述建议类含 `\n` 换行，由 `.txt.suggest-body` 的 `white-space: pre-line` 保留。 3. 模块顺序 = `reportDetails` 数组顺序（report.json 已保证 sort 升序），模块内排序 NO_DATA → NO_FILL → DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST，**不得重排**。 4. `MODULE_ROWS` 内 tag 按文案内容分类：以「描述建议」开头 → 描述建议；含「可以为你加分哦」→ 可加分；含「是简历中的重要信息，请完善」→ 需完善；其他 → 建议。文案一律原样。 5. 分数未算完（runStatus≠1）时不出 HTML 版；`score` 为 -1/-2 时填 `—`。 6. `beatPercent` 缺失（如 score=100）时填「报告生成完成」，不展示百分比。 --- ## 4. 扩展节（非接口内容，可选，追加到 HTML 报告末尾） 以下内容**不属于**报告标准返回，仅当用户要求"给整改方案/求职建议"时才追加，且必须**追加在 HTML 报告末尾**并标注"以下为扩展分析"： - 综合评价段落； - 按紧急/重要/锦上添花分级的整改计划； - 求职赛道建议； - 整改后简历草稿。

# wps.header_footers.header_font

## 1. wps.header_footers.header_font

#### 功能说明

设置在线文字文档页眉的字体。

**幂等性**：是 — safe

> 支持多属性合并写：font_style 中多个属性（font_name/font_size/bold/italic/underline/color_index 等）会全部生效，不再只取第一个属性。
> 空字体属性（font_style 为空对象且未传 key/value）返回显式报错（400100），不再静默。

#### 调用示例

文档设置：

```json
{
  "file_id": "<FILE_ID>",
  "font_style": {
    "bold": true
  },
  "header_footer_type": 1,
  "key": "Bold",
  "section_index": 1,
  "value": "true"
}
```

#### 参数说明

- `file_id` (string, 三选一必填: `url` / `link_id` / `file_id`): 文件 id；与 url、link_id 三选一
- `font_style` (object, 可选): 字体样式对象
- `header_footer_type` (number, 可选): header footer type
- `key` (string, 可选): 属性名
- `link_id` (string, 三选一必填: `url` / `link_id` / `file_id`): 分享 id；与 url、file_id 三选一
- `section_index` (number, 可选): 节索引，从 1 开始
- `url` (string, 三选一必填: `url` / `link_id` / `file_id`): 文档 URL；与 link_id、file_id 三选一
- `value` (string, 可选): 属性值

#### 返回值说明

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "成功",
  "data": {}
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `code` | number | 0 表示成功 |
| `data` | object | 业务数据 |
| `message` | string | 结果说明 |

# 模块二：段落格式

段落对齐、缩进和行间距设置。枚举值见 [enums.md](enums.md)。

---

## 对齐方式

### modifyParagraphAlignment — 修改指定段落对齐

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| n | uint32 | 是 | 段落索引 |
| algMode | enum | 是 | 对齐方式，见 [WdParagraphAlignment](enums.md#wdparagraphalignment--对齐方式) |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyParagraphAlignment", "param": {"n": 1, "algMode": 1}}
```

### modifyRangeAlignment — 修改区间内段落对齐

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| begin | uint32 | 是 | 开始位置 |
| end | uint32 | 是 | 结束位置 |
| algMode | enum | 是 | 对齐方式，见 [WdParagraphAlignment](enums.md#wdparagraphalignment--对齐方式) |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyRangeAlignment", "param": {"begin": 0, "end": 200, "algMode": 3}}
```

---

## 缩进

以下 6 个命令共享相同的参数模式，区别在于定位方式和缩进方向。

### 段落缩进命令（按 n 定位）

| 命令 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `modifyParagraphLeftIndent` | 修改左缩进 |
| `modifyParagraphRightIndent` | 修改右缩进 |
| `modifyParagraphFirstLineIndent` | 修改首行缩进（正值首行缩进，负值悬挂缩进） |

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| n | uint32 | 是 | 段落索引 |
| indent | float | 是 | 缩进值（unit=pt 时为磅，unit=ch 时为字符数） |
| unit | string | 否 | 缩进单位，默认 `pt`（磅）；可选 `ch`（字符） |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyParagraphLeftIndent", "param": {"n": 1, "indent": 24}}
```

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyParagraphFirstLineIndent", "param": {"n": 2, "indent": 2, "unit": "ch"}}
```

### 区间缩进命令（按 begin/end 定位）

| 命令 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `modifyRangeLeftIndent` | 修改区间左缩进 |
| `modifyRangeRightIndent` | 修改区间右缩进 |
| `modifyRangeFirstLineIndent` | 修改区间首行缩进 |

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| begin | uint32 | 是 | 开始位置 |
| end | uint32 | 是 | 结束位置 |
| indent | float | 是 | 缩进值 |
| unit | string | 否 | 缩进单位，默认 `pt`；可选 `ch` |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyRangeLeftIndent", "param": {"begin": 0, "end": 200, "indent": 36, "unit": "pt"}}
```

---

## 行间距

### modifyParagraphLineSpacing — 修改段落行间距

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| n | uint32 | 是 | 段落索引 |
| spacingRule | enum | 是 | 行间距规则，见 [WdLineSpacing](enums.md#wdlinespacing--行间距) |
| spacingValue | float | 条件必填 | spacingRule 为 4(Exactly) 或 5(Multiple) 时必填，单位磅 |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyParagraphLineSpacing", "param": {"n": 1, "spacingRule": 0}}
```

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyParagraphLineSpacing", "param": {"n": 2, "spacingRule": 5, "spacingValue": 36}}
```

### modifyRangeLineSpacing — 修改区间行间距

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| begin | uint32 | 是 | 开始位置 |
| end | uint32 | 是 | 结束位置 |
| spacingRule | enum | 是 | 行间距规则，见 [WdLineSpacing](enums.md#wdlinespacing--行间距) |
| spacingValue | float | 条件必填 | spacingRule 为 4(Exactly) 或 5(Multiple) 时必填，单位磅 |

```json
{"id": "file_xxx", "command": "modifyRangeLineSpacing", "param": {"begin": 0, "end": 500, "spacingRule": 1}}
```

# 课程配置与授权
## 课程工作台

先调用 `salesnail_get_course_workspace`。它返回课程角色、分组、学员、组长、进组链接、口令、助教邀请链接、受邀讲师、材料权限和自动审批状态。

不要自己拼接链接，也不要通过猜测 ID 修改分组或学员。

## 配置操作

课程所有讲师可通过 `salesnail_preview_course_setup_patch` 预览：

- update_course：名称、时间、公司、描述、人数、组数和课程模式字段。
- add_group / edit_group。
- move_learner。
- set_leader。
- remove_invited_teacher。
- set_team_material_access。
- set_learner_material_access。

受邀讲师不能执行这些配置。分组删除不开放。邀请助教时向用户提供 workspace 返回的助教链接，由对方用自己的账号加入。

用户确认后调用 `salesnail_apply_course_setup_patch`，并以返回的最新 workspace 为准。

# metadata data-table property-bindings-update

> Capability id: `metadata.data_table.property_bindings_update` · Domain: `metadata`.

```bash
ae-cli metadata data-table property-bindings-update --project-id <project_id> --data-table-id <id> --bind-properties '<bind_json>'
ae-cli metadata data-table property-bindings-update --project-id <project_id> --data-table-id <id> --unbind-properties '<unbind_json>'
```

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project-id` / `-p` | Yes | Numeric project ID. |
| `--data-table-id` | Yes | Data table ID. |
| `--bind-properties` | No | Properties to bind JSON array. Each item includes `property_name` and `property_scope`. |
| `--unbind-properties` | No | Properties to unbind JSON array. Each item includes `property_name` and `property_scope`. |

This is a write command. Use the direct property dimension-table commands when binding a single property is the user-facing goal.

# Copy Methodologies

Use these methods to raise copy quality before producing final options. They are not templates to copy mechanically; they are judgment systems for creating, selecting, and improving copy.

## 1. 事实先于修辞：诚信型销售文案法

### Core judgment

Good sales copy does not win by sounding fierce. It wins by making a believable promise with facts, demonstration, empathy, and clear logic.

### Use when

- Product copy
- Detail pages
- Conversion posts
- Short video voiceover
- Sales pages
- Functional KV copy
- Promotional copy

### Rules

- First attract attention, but make sure the attention leads back to the product or problem.
- After creating interest, quickly point the reader toward the product value.
- Write for the real buyer, not for everyone.
- Show product performance instead of only claiming superiority.
- Prefer facts over adjectives, and demonstrations over slogans.
- Build desire from real needs, scarcity, self-image, or emotional projection.
- Earn credibility by proving that the brand understands the user's problem.
- Challenge category assumptions only when supported by facts or a new perspective.
- Turn facts into a proposition; do not dress unsupported claims as facts.

### Avoid

- Attention tricks unrelated to the product.
- Empty claims such as better, stronger, more premium, or more advanced.
- Treating consumers as targets to conquer instead of people to understand.
- Artistic self-expression that does not move the reader toward action.

## 2. 先准后狠：产品定义、承诺提炼与标题爆破法

### Core judgment

The force of copy comes after accuracy. First define the product, the buyer, the promise, and the proof. Then write sharp headlines and memorable expressions.

### Use when

- Brand advertising
- Product advertising
- Long-form conversion copy
- Social selling posts
- KV headlines
- Detail pages
- Event promotion
- Short video hooks

### Rules

- Describe the product in 20-30 words before writing: feature, function, target consumer, and emotional or spiritual benefit.
- Define the promise to the consumer. The more specific the promise, the stronger it is.
- Do not write a promise that you cannot believe or prove.
- Establish a simple, original, extendable Big Idea before writing executions.
- Before drafting body copy, write at least 15 headline options.
- Create headlines through story, novelty, or newsworthiness.
- Use creative methods such as personification, reverse thinking, scenario imagination, cultural or news hooks, metaphor, symbol, association, exclamation, layout ideas, and familiar cues.
- Body copy should use facts, numbers, true experience, and concrete benefits.
- Address the target audience directly.
- Let length follow the sales task. Short is not always better; clear and persuasive is better.
- Think visually while writing so the copy can work with design.
- Focus one ad on one main promise.
- Edit like a news editor: cut, arrange, and place the strongest information where it will be seen.

### Avoid

- Writing pretty sentences first and reverse-engineering the strategy later.
- Using abstract words instead of concrete promises.
- Stacking too many selling points in one execution.
- Using obscure words or complicated phrasing.
- Letting novelty pull the headline away from the product.

## 3. 标题先行：社媒点击触发器与兑现法

### Core judgment

A social title is not a summary. It is a click decision trigger. It must reduce comprehension cost, activate a psychological motive, and give the user a reason to enter the content.

### Use when

- Xiaohongshu titles
- WeChat article titles
- Short video cover copy
- Social post openings
- Content marketing
- Seed posts
- Event posts

### Rules

- Use numbers to create certainty only when the number is true and useful.
- Use trends only when they connect to brand, product, or audience value.
- Hit emotion first: anxiety, exhaustion, desire, relief, grievance, clarity, or being seen.
- Leave a curiosity gap tied to the actual content.
- Create contrast between two states, such as effort versus no result, recovery versus loss of control, or low price versus high value.
- State the benefit clearly: save time, avoid mistakes, learn something, feel better, choose better.
- Use specific identity labels so the reader feels addressed.
- Ask questions that already exist in the user's mind.
- Add scenes, actions, time, body feelings, or life details.
- Use reverse expressions such as do not, stop, not recommended, or never only when the article can support the claim.
- The title must be fulfilled by the content.
- Each title should have at least one clear psychological trigger.

### Avoid

- Clickbait that the content cannot deliver.
- Fake numbers.
- Trend-jacking without relevance.
- Emotion without value.
- Suspense disconnected from the content.
- Generic formulas such as must read, save this, or too good without a real angle.

## 4. 作者性文案法：人设、分寸与脾气

### Core judgment

Copy with no AI taste needs a clear speaking subject. Before writing, define who is speaking, from what position, with what personality, limits, and value stance.

### Use when

- Brand manifesto
- Brand attitude copy
- Social content systems
- Founder brands
- Lifestyle brands
- Cultural brands
- Product launch copy
- Value statements
- Crisis or response copy

### Rules

- Define the brand's speaking subject: what kind of person does the brand resemble?
- Before writing, answer: who is speaking, from what stance, and what expression must be made?
- Let brand personality come from founder spirit, product traits, user interaction, service behavior, team habits, and long-term brand accumulation.
- Build personality from both brand truth and the user's ideal self.
- Keep the writer's ego smaller than the brand, product, and service.
- Start from product or business traits, find the shared feeling with the user, then express it through the brand's value stance.
- Give the brand a point of view; it does not need to please everyone.
- Every expression should accumulate brand tone, not only chase a topic.
- The tone can be gentle, sharp, plain, calm, rebellious, or restrained, but it must serve the same brand core.
- Test authorship by asking: if the logo is removed, can the copy still feel like this brand?

### Avoid

- Mistaking casual language for humanity.
- Forcing emotion or golden sentences just to avoid AI taste.
- Letting the writer's personality cover the brand.
- Changing brand personality with every trend.
- Imitating another brand's tone without your own speaking subject.
- Becoming average, templated, or safe.

## 5. 文化转译文案法：商品、语境与身份想象

### Core judgment

High-level brand copy does not only introduce a product. It places the product inside culture, desire, identity, and a way of living.

### Use when

- Brand manifesto
- Lifestyle brands
- Bookstores
- Art spaces
- Exhibitions
- Premium retail
- City commercial spaces
- Brand events
- Premium personal care
- Fragrance, fashion, and aesthetic consumption brands

### Rules

- Do not only write function; write the lifestyle, desire, and identity carried by the product.
- Place the product inside cultural coordinates: literature, film, art, philosophy, city, season, body, memory, scent, love, work, escape.
- Use juxtaposition to create association between culture, product, emotion, and scene.
- Use parallel structures to create rhythm and a set of life fragments.
- Use concrete objects to wake abstract emotion: books, pens, coffee, old photos, scent, clothes, streets, moonlight.
- Turn consumption into a spiritual action: expression, escape, confession, reunion, loyalty, departure, or self-definition.
- Use light contradiction or ambiguity to add intellectual tension.
- Let event or product information land naturally from the cultural narrative.
- Keep all expressions unified by the brand's cultural personality.
- Long copy must still have rhythm, imagery, and a clear spiritual thread.

### Avoid

- Piling up cultural names to look premium.
- Using references as decoration instead of meaning.
- Making readers feel excluded or confused.
- Writing beautiful stream-of-consciousness copy that forgets the business task.
- Copying the tone of a famous brand instead of learning its translation structure.
- Using empty lifestyle labels such as tasteful, understands life, or high-quality living.

## 6. 对一个人说话：广告是说服，不是表演

### Core judgment

Advertising is not a performance for an imagined crowd. It is a clear, purposeful conversation with one real person. Copy should persuade someone to understand, trust, care, act, buy, or share.

### Use when

- Long copy
- Brand advertising
- Product advertising
- Conversion copy
- Proposal copy
- KV copy
- Video scripts
- Any work that must become effective, not only impressive

### Rules

- Imagine one specific person sitting across from you.
- Write like a real conversation, not a broadcast or award entry.
- Sell something: a belief, reason, action, trust, trial, or purchase.
- Let visuals support persuasion; do not let them become decorative intelligence.
- Copy must carry the idea, not leave all responsibility to the image.
- Judge effectiveness by asking whether the reader is more likely to understand, believe, try, buy, or share.
- Do not write for awards. If effective work wins awards, that is secondary.
- The cleverer the line, the more carefully it must be checked for clarity.
- Entertainment must serve persuasion.
- If the audience must work too hard to decode the idea, the work may be too far from the consumer.

### Avoid

- Treating cleverness as effectiveness.
- Letting awards define success.
- Turning the visual into a puzzle with no sales reason.
- Shouting at everyone and moving no one.
- Writing for industry applause instead of consumer response.

## 7. 言简义丰法：用最少文字装下最大信息张力

### Core judgment

Strong short copy is not merely brief or beautiful. It uses the fewest necessary words to carry information, emotion, image, brand task, and memorability.

### Use when

- Campaign slogans
- KV headlines
- Poster copy
- Social titles
- Brand attitude lines
- Video end lines
- Any line that must be remembered, repeated, or shared

### Rules

- One sentence should usually carry one core idea.
- Prefer simple sentence structures and direct statements.
- Cut every word that does not add meaning, rhythm, image, or force.
- Do not cut so much that the promise, subject, or emotional meaning becomes incomplete.
- Add one meaningful pause, contrast, or unexpected word only when it remains logically sound.
- Give the sentence a clear emotional direction.
- Read it aloud to test rhythm, repeatability, and memorability.
- Bind the line to a brand stance, product truth, or human value, not only to clever phrasing.
- If removing the brand or product makes the line equally usable for anyone, strengthen brand ownership.

### Avoid

- Short lines with missing meaning.
- Clever but illogical word pairings.
- Rhythm that hides emptiness.
- Abstract values without product or brand connection.
- Treating "viral" as emotional provocation instead of useful persuasion.

## 8. 缺点转资产法：把品牌短板写成可爱的立场

### Core judgment

Not every brand should pretend to be premium, cool, or fashionable. Some brands become more valuable when they admit a real weakness and translate it into a believable consumer virtue.

### Use when

- Value brands
- Traditional or regional brands
- Brand refresh work
- Practical categories
- Price-advantage products
- Brands seen as uncool, ordinary, cheap, old, local, plain, or unfashionable
- Long-term brand character building

### Rules

- Start from the brand's real situation. Do not disguise the brand as another category.
- Identify the positive value behind the weakness: cheap can become smart living, plain can become honest, old can become reliable, local can become close.
- Use self-awareness to lower resistance, but keep brand confidence.
- Translate price advantage into life wisdom, not low-end signaling.
- Build a stable voice, such as dry humor, plain honesty, restraint, warmth, or practical intelligence.
- Put promotional information inside a larger life attitude whenever possible.
- Repeat the same personality and value over time so the copy becomes a brand asset.
- Let execution vary by occasion, but keep the underlying stance consistent.

### Avoid

- Turning self-awareness into self-deprecation.
- Writing only "cheap" and damaging perceived value.
- Forced youth slang or internet tone.
- One-off jokes with no brand accumulation.
- Reframing a weakness without a real business advantage behind it.

## 9. 现代汉语广告语法法：先让句子成立，再让句子有广告性

### Core judgment

Advertising copy is not ordinary explanation. It must actively shape Chinese characters, words, syntax, tone, rhythm, context, and semantic displacement so that a sentence compresses meaning, creates pause, and becomes memorable.

### Use when

- Campaign lines
- KV copy
- Short-form social copy
- Naming and taglines
- Poster copy
- Any line that feels correct but too plain
- Any draft that has insight but lacks advertising tension

### Rules

- 字词层: Test whether the key word can be changed, added to, removed from, split, echoed, redefined, or made into a meaningful pun.
- 句法层: Use positive/negative, omission, hypothesis, choice, parallel clauses, repeated clauses, and reversal to create tension.
- 语气层: Decide whether the line should speak as reminder, confession, command, provocation, narration, dry humor, question, or intimate aside.
- 语境层: Write inside the actual context of image, medium, brand, audience, and scene.
- 创异层: Create "reasonable abnormality": the line may feel unusual, but it must become more correct after the reader thinks about it.
- Strategy conclusions cannot be pasted directly as copy. They must be re-expressed through syntax, tone, and image.
- Wordplay is useful only when it clarifies or sharpens the communication task.

### Avoid

- Word games that reduce clarity.
- Puns, split characters, or homophones as the idea itself.
- Beautiful sentences with weak product ownership.
- Lines detached from visual context, media format, or user situation.
- Copy that only restates strategy in a prettier tone.

## Quality Loop

Before finalizing copy:

1. State the task: awareness, trust, desire, action, conversion, or brand meaning.
2. Pick the relevant methodology from this file.
3. Generate multiple options.
4. Eliminate lines that are vague, unproven, over-clever, off-brand, or not addressed to a real person.
5. Rewrite the strongest options for clarity, specificity, and psychological force.
6. Recommend one option and explain why it works.

# 背景标签：校园 · 创作素材与采样库（漫剧）

> 本文全部为灵感启发，**不强制命中、不作评分依据**，可自由组合/原创/豁免。
> 权威规则（红线/互斥/叠加/融梗）见同目录 `meta.yaml`。

## 一、创作素材指引

### 1. 节奏适配逻辑
常见节奏：校园日常 → 冲突/心动触发 → 成长/破局 → 蜕变升级 → 情感/热血高潮。付费节点可落在心动瞬间、首次逆袭、成长转折等处。

### 2. 核心变体素材
#### 题材类型变体
1. 青春纯爱型：心动、暗恋、双向奔赴
2. 热血逆袭型：学渣翻身、竞赛/体育热血
3. 成长治愈型：自我和解、友情羁绊
4. 校园悬疑型：青春外壳下的反转谜题

#### 冲突模式变体
1. 心动悸动型：情感拉扯与甜蜜
2. 逆袭蜕变型：从弱势到闪耀
3. 友情羁绊型：青春同行与成长

### 3. 钩子参考模板
- 开篇钩子：重回十七岁，这一次我不会再错过你
- 集末钩子参考：
  1. 心动式：他低头的瞬间，整个世界都安静了
  2. 逆袭式：被嘲笑的差生，模考杀进了年级前三

## 二、人设加成参考
1. 主角：青春质感、成长弧光清晰
2. 反派/对手：竞争或误会驱动，避免脸谱化
3. 配角：友情/情感的青春共鸣载体

# Skill 5 · 附录 03：输出契约（JSON Schema + Markdown 八节）

> **触发阅读条件**：生成 result.json / report.md 前必读；排查输出结构不合规时。

## 1. 硬性输出要求（不可协商）

### 硬性要求 1：严禁陈述财报已知事实，必须输出"数据背后的逻辑"

- **绝不重复** skill3 已给出的事实型数据，例如 ❌ "某某银行 2024 年零售营收 xxx 亿、同比 +x.x%"
- **必须穿透到**「**为什么是这个数字**」——指向**决策选择、领导意图、治理约束、组织惯性**四个层面之一
- 每一段结论**必须落在"数据解读 + 行为归因 + 治理解释"**三段式上，不得只堆指标
- **反例**：「A银行零售贷款占比 55%，领先B银行 12pp。」（只是事实）
- **正例**：「A银行零售贷款占比持续领先B银行 10pp+，并非起点差异，而是**田惠宇任期内持续 9 年将 KPI 权重向零售倾斜 60%+**（治理）**叠加** 2013 年钱荒时点**果断压降非标释放的 RWA 被定向分配至零售**（关键节点决策）的复利结果。」（数据 + 决策 + 治理）

### 硬性要求 2：识别风险点 —— 明确指出基准行在历次领导更替中的"战略摇摆"点及诱因

- **至少输出 2 个具体摇摆点案例**，每个必须包含：
  1. **时点**（精确到季度）与**事件名称**
  2. **前任战略口径** vs **新任战略口径**的原文对照
  3. **诱因归因**：从 4 类中明确选择 1~2 类
     - `leader_turnover` 领导更替驱动
     - `shareholder_will` 股东意志（国资深化 / 战投引入）
     - `regulator_push` 监管倒逼
     - `org_inertia` 组织惯性反噬
  4. **三类证据**（须齐备至少 2 类）：
     - 年报口径变化（原文引用）
     - 组织架构调整（部门新设/撤并事件）
     - 资源投向反转（资源指标折返点数据）
  5. **代价评估**：引用第三阶段 what-if 区间，量化摇摆造成的 ROE / 不良率机会成本

### 硬性要求 3：建议方案 —— 为基准行设计一套"战略隔离带"与"治理韧性"提升方案

- **必须分三类**组织建议（**缺一不可**）：

| 建议类别 | 定位 | 数量 | 示例方向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **① 战略隔离带** | 让核心战略不因领导更替而摇摆 | 3~5 条 | 战略中长期锚定机制 / KPI 多任期权重绑定 / 战略委员会决议不可逆条款 |
| **② 治理韧性** | 提升组织承受外部冲击的弹性 | 3~5 条 | 董事会专业委员会常态化 / 风险偏好白皮书每任更新 / 组织架构稳定性保护机制 |
| **③ 关键人事安排** | 确保人才梯队服务于战略延续性 | 3~5 条 | 核心条线"任期跨周期"人选要求 / 零售+科技+风险三条线接班人池 / 跨任期 KPI 考核 |

- **每条建议必须含四要素**：**动作 → 理由 → 数据依据 → 预期效果**；缺一不可
- **禁止空泛表述**：❌ "建议关注 / 建议重视 / 建议加强" 一律视为不合格

## 2. Markdown 报告标准章节结构（八节）

> 不可随意增删，编号与标题保持一致。每节内部的具体小节可根据数据可得性裁剪，但**章节主干不得缺省**。

```
# 战略与治理分析报告
## 执行摘要（≤ 600 字）
    · 5 条核心结论（战略定力排名 / 基准行 TOP2 摇摆点 / 言行一致度均值 / 政策适配排名 / 建议总览）
    · 战略韧性得分一览表（5 行）

## 01 时间骨架：周期划分、领导画像与组织演进
    · 1.1 五周期表 + 宏观背景
    · 1.2 五行历任董事长/行长 Gantt（含背景类型）
    · 1.3 组织变革热力图（零售/科技/风险 × 年份）

## 02 穿透式"言行比对"
    · 2.1 战略关键词漂移轨迹（基准行 vs 4 标杆，2015~最新）
    · 2.2 "说的 vs 做的" ρ 矩阵（真战略 / 口号 / 话术 三色标注）
    · 2.3 领导更替下的战略延续性三色判定（进化 / 渐进 / 换届）

## 03 关键节点反事实推演
    · 3.1 五个关键节点（2013 钱荒 / 2016 MPA / 2018 资管新规 / 2020 疫情 / 2022 房地产）
    · 3.2 差异化决策逻辑（资本约束 / 风险偏好 / 业务结构依赖三维归因）
    · 3.3 基准行 what-if 模拟（三种资产配置路径 × 当前不良率/ROE 区间）
         —— 每条结论必须标注「模型推演，非事实」+ 置信度

## 04 治理结构影响机制
    · 4.1 董事会专业委员会议事频率 × 业绩波动相关性
    · 4.2 股东意志传导链（股权结构变化 → 风险边界 + 分红策略）
    · 4.3 战略韧性五角雷达 & 得分表

## 05 【风险点】基准行战略摇摆点诊断  ← 硬性要求 2 落点
    · 5.1 摇摆点 #1（YYYY-Qx · 事件名）
         - 前后战略口径原文对照
         - 诱因归因 & 三类证据
         - 代价评估（引用 3.3 区间）
         - 教训提炼
    · 5.2 摇摆点 #2
    · （如有） 5.3 摇摆点 #3

## 06 【建议】战略隔离带 & 治理韧性提升方案  ← 硬性要求 3 落点
    · 6.1 战略隔离带（3~5 条，每条四要素）
    · 6.2 治理韧性（3~5 条，每条四要素）
    · 6.3 关键人事安排（3~5 条，每条四要素）

## 07 数据窗口与降级说明
    · 分析窗口 / 数据窗口 / 已降级条目清单 / 数据源索引

## 08 免责声明
    · "本报告由 AI 基于上市银行公开披露信息生成，仅供研究参考，不构成任何投资建议，亦不构成对任何个股的推荐"
```

## 3. JSON 结构骨架

```json

    "schema_version": "sg-v1.1",
```

## 4. 输出文件清单

| 文件 | 内容 | 面向 |
|---|---|---|
| `~/RetailAnalysis/data/strategy_governance_result.json` | 结构化主输出：5 家银行画像卡 + 四阶段分析结果 + 战略韧性评分 + 基准行风险点 + 建议方案 | 机器可读 |
| `~/RetailAnalysis/output/<bank>/strategy_governance_report.md` | 分析报告（Markdown，面向高管阅读） | 人类阅读 |
| `~/RetailAnalysis/output/<bank>/战略与治理分析报告.pdf` | 默认生成的 PDF 交付物 | 董事会 / 战略委员会 |

## 5. PDF 上下文完整性红线

生成 HTML/PDF 前必须运行 `scripts/render_strategy_governance_report.py`。以下字段全部不得为空：

- `phase1.leader_timeline_html`、`phase1.org_heatmap_html`
- `phase2.consistency_table_html`、`phase2.continuity_items`
- `phase3.key_nodes`（5 个节点，每个包含 `decisions` 和 `what_if`）
- `phase4.board_activity_html`、`phase4.shareholder_events`、`phase4.resilience_scores`
- `swing_points` 至少 2 个
- `recommendations` 三类均非空

禁止直接将原始 `strategy_governance_result.json` 作为模板 `ctx`。原始字段与 PDF 模板字段不一致，直接调用会触发占位符并丢失中间产物信息。

## 6. 质量红线（与"输出要求"三条硬性约束配套）

1. **禁止复述财报事实**（对应硬性要求 1）：任何结论段落不得以"X 银行 YYYY 年零售营收 xxx 亿"类事实开头，必须以"**数据背后的逻辑**"切入；每个结论落在「数据解读 + 行为归因 + 治理解释」三段式。
2. **战略摇摆点 ≥ 2 个、证据 ≥ 2 类、诱因枚举受限**（对应硬性要求 2）：诱因必须从 `leader_turnover / shareholder_will / regulator_push / org_inertia` 四类中选择，不允许自造；三类证据至少齐备 2 项。
3. **建议四要素齐备、三类分栏齐备**（对应硬性要求 3）：「战略隔离带 / 治理韧性 / 关键人事安排」三栏缺一不可；每条建议必须含「动作 → 理由 → 数据依据 → 预期效果」，禁止"建议关注""建议重视"等空泛表述。
4. **反事实必须标注**：所有反事实推演结论显式标注「**模型推演，非事实**」+ 置信度（低/中/高）且给出区间（min ~ max）。
5. **言行一致度必须量化**：不得只写"言行一致"或"名不副实"，必须给出 ρ 值与判定理由（真战略 / 口号 / 话术）。
6. **数据缺失不补**：2004~2014 段数据缺失时显式降级，不插值、不臆测。
7. **领导画像来源明示**：每位领导的任期起止必须注明来自"xx 银行 YYYY 年年报 · 董事会成员简历"，避免网络搜索未校验。
8. **股东影响链须可追溯**：股权结构变化 → 风险偏好改变的因果链必须有年报或公告支撑，不做推测性跳跃。
9. **执行工程硬约束**：
   - 大文件（md/html/json）**禁止**单次 `write_to_file` 写入 >8KB；禁止 `execute_command` 内嵌长 heredoc 脚本
   - `~/RetailAnalysis/data/partial/sg_*.json` 12 个中间产物**必须齐备**
   - 前置核查 `skill5_preflight.sh` 任一项 `BLOCK` 未解决**禁止**进入四阶段分析
   - 再次执行时必须先走 Step 0.5 增量判断

e3a1d127881f56a0b42848c4297a2b25d310f383.text:
# 重整计划草案编制 — 工作流程详情

## Phase 1：信息收集与分析
收集债务人信息/债权概况/可供偿债资源/经营方向。分析债务人持续经营能力和重整可行性。

## Phase 2：债权分类与清算地板测试
按第113条法定顺位分类。计算模拟清算清偿率（假设清算场景下各顺位受偿比例）。重整清偿率必须≥清算清偿率（清算地板测试），否则方案可能被否决。

## Phase 3：设计债权调整方案
确定各类债权调整比例和方式。原则：同类公平/担保债权优先/职工债权全额/普通债权合理调整。

## Phase 4：设计债权受偿方案
确定清偿方式（现金/股票/债券/实物/组合）/清偿期限（一次性/分期）/资金来源（经营收入/投资人出资/资产变现）。

## Phase 5：编制经营方案
业务方向/经营措施/盈利预测/可行性分析。经营方案须具体可行，不是空泛口号。

## Phase 6：编制出资人权益调整方案
如有需要：股权稀释比例/股权让渡安排/公平性说明。

## Phase 7：组装草案与自检
按第81条法定章节组装完整草案。自检：法定章节完整性/清算地板测试/同类公平/数据一致性。产出 reorg_plan_summary.json。

**和解协议特殊处理**：procedure_type=settlement时，章节调整为：和解债权范围/清偿方案/担保安排/执行监督/违约后果。

---
name: criminal-law-elements-offenses-translator
name_en: criminal-law-elements-offenses-translator
description: Use when translating, reviewing, or drafting criminal-law English where terms must match criminal-law system, offense element, mental state, act requirement, offense grade, offender role, or specific crime name; especially criminal law/penal law, basic principles, elements of crime, mens rea, actus reus, felony, misdemeanor, capital punishment, principal, accomplice, homicide, murder, manslaughter, mayhem, arson, robbery, larceny, burglary, rape, and white collar crime.
---
# Criminal Law Elements Offenses Translator

## R - Reading

Scope signals:

- Covers criminal law, basic principles, elements of crime, mens rea, actus reus, felony, misdemeanor, principal, accomplice, and specific offenses.
- Actus reus and mens rea should be treated as components rather than names for the crime itself.
- It distinguishes homicide, murder, manslaughter, robbery, larceny, burglary, rape, and white collar crime.

## I - Interpretation

Criminal-law translation must preserve the level of analysis: field, principle, element, actor role, offense grade, or specific crime. Many English words look ordinary but are technical. For example, actus reus is not simply “犯罪”, burglary is not always “入室盗窃”, and principal in criminal law is not the civil-law principal.

This skill maps terms by criminal-law system, element structure, culpability, conduct, harm, and procedural stage.

## A1 - Past Application

Key criminal-law distinctions:

- criminal law and penal law emphasize different aspects of the field.
- mens rea and actus reus are element concepts, not complete offenses.
- felony/misdemeanor is common-law classification and may not map directly to PRC crime severity.
- principal/accomplice/accessory require checking participation role and legal system.
- homicide, murder, manslaughter, larceny, robbery, burglary, and rape have jurisdiction-specific elements.

## A2 - Future Trigger

Invoke this skill for:

- criminal-law translations, indictments, criminal judgments, extradition materials, sanctions reports involving crimes, compliance investigations, or comparative-law analysis;
- questions about offense names, criminal elements, culpability, act requirement, offense grade, offender role, or criminal punishment;
- review of possible false friends between civil-law and criminal-law uses of the same English term.

Do not invoke for general litigation procedure unless the task centers on offense terminology or criminal responsibility.

## E - Execution

1. Identify whether the term is field, principle, element, role, grade, punishment, or offense name.
2. Identify legal system and jurisdiction: PRC, U.S., U.K., common law, civil law, international criminal law, or comparative explanation.
3. For elements, separate conduct, mental state, causation, harm, justification, and defense.
4. For offense names, check whether the English term's elements match the Chinese concept.
5. For offender roles, distinguish principal, accomplice, accessory, aider, abettor, and civil-law principal.
6. Output recommended term, offense/element level, jurisdiction note, rejected alternatives, and caution.

## B - Boundary

This skill does not assess guilt, sentencing exposure, extraditability, or criminal liability. It supports terminology and drafting review. For prosecution, defense, appeal, or court procedure, coordinate with `procedure-litigation-term-mapper`.

## Related Skills

- `procedure-litigation-term-mapper`: for criminal procedure and prosecution/defense procedural terms.
- `foreign-legal-english-term-precision`: for defendant/accused/suspect and party labels.

## Audit

- Distillation: merged criminal field, element, grade, participant, and offense-name terms because they require one offense-analysis method.
- Quality gates: V1/V2/V3 passed in `../verified.md`.

---
name: customize
description: >
  Guided customization of your employment practice profile — change one thing
  without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust jurisdictional
  footprint, risk posture, escalation contacts, hiring review rules,
  termination review rules, handbook positions, investigation preferences,
  or matter workspace paths. Use when the user says "change my [thing]",
  "add a jurisdiction", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
argument-hint: "[section name, or describe what you want to change]"
---

# /customize

## When this runs

The user typed `/employment-legal:customize`. They want to change something
in their practice profile — a jurisdiction, a risk posture, an escalation
contact, a handbook position — without re-running the whole cold-start
interview and without hand-editing YAML.

## What to do

1. **Read the config.** Read
   `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/employment-legal/practice-profile.md`
   (and `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/company-profile.md` one
   level up). If the plugin config does not exist or still contains
   `[PLACEHOLDER]` values, say:

   > You haven't run setup yet. Run `/employment-legal:cold-start-interview`
   > first — customize is for adjusting a profile you already have.

2. **Show the customizable map.** List what's in the profile, grouped, with a
   one-line summary of the current value:

   - **Company / who you are** — name, industry, practice setting, jurisdictions
     *(shared across all 12 plugins — changes flow through
     `company-profile.md`)*
   - **Jurisdictional footprint** — states (and countries) where employees
     work, single-state vs. multi-state, and any upcoming expansion. This
     drives state-specific supplement logic.
   - **Risk posture** — conservative / middle / aggressive, what each means
     for flagging termination risk, restrictive covenant enforceability, and
     leave accommodation
   - **People** — HR partners, people team lead, outside counsel, escalation
     chain, investigation sponsor
   - **Hiring review** — offer letter template, restrictive covenants
     posture, background check vendor, standard at-will language
   - **Termination review** — severance framework, release language, final
     pay timing rules per state, high-risk flags
   - **Handbook** — handbook file path, state supplements approach, review
     cadence
   - **Investigation preferences** — privileged labeling, interview protocol,
     audience-specific summary templates
   - **Workflow** — matter workspaces, leave tracker cadence, expansion
     project paths
   - **Integrations** — HRIS / Slack / document storage status, fallbacks

3. **Ask what they want to change.**

   > What would you like to adjust? Pick a section, or describe the change in
   > your own words.

4. **Make the change.** Show the current value, ask for the new value, explain
   what changes downstream, confirm, write it to the config.

   Examples:
     and `/termination-review` will start applying WA rules. `/handbook-
     updates` will prompt for a WA supplement. `/hiring-review` will now
     flag non-compete attempts in WA (unenforceable)."
   - *Severance framework 2 weeks/year → 4 weeks/year:* "`/termination-
     review` will use the new baseline in severance calculations."
   - *Risk posture middle → conservative:* "I'll flag more terminations for
     escalation, recommend more protective release language, and be stricter
     on restrictive covenants."

5. **For shared-profile changes** (company name, industry, jurisdictions,
   practice setting, stage): write to
   `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/company-profile.md` and note:

   > This change affects all 12 plugins — any plugin that reads your
   > jurisdiction footprint now sees [new value].

6. **Close.**

   > Done. Your next output will reflect the change. Anything else? You can
   > run `/employment-legal:customize` anytime.

## Guardrails

- **Never delete a section.** If the user wants to "remove" a jurisdiction,
  offer to mark it `[Not currently staffed — retain rules for re-entry]` and
  explain that going to `[Not configured]` will drop state-specific
  flagging.
- **Flag internal inconsistency.** If the change would make the profile
  inconsistent (e.g., CA in the footprint + aggressive non-compete posture;
  or risk posture aggressive + "every termination goes to outside counsel"),
  flag the tension.
- **Flag guardrail degradation.** The pre-flight citation check, source
  attribution tags, and `[verify]` tags on cited statutes are load-bearing —
  do not remove. The `[review]` flag is load-bearing — explain the trade-off
  before adjusting.
- **One change at a time.** Don't re-ask the whole interview.

---
name: matter-workspace
description: >
  Manage matter workspaces — create, list, switch, close, or detach the
  active matter. Use in multi-client private practice to keep one client's
  context separate from another, or when a substantive skill needs to know
  which matter it's working in.
argument-hint: "<new | list | switch | close | none> [slug]"
---

# /matter-workspace

Practitioners work across multiple clients and matters. A matter workspace keeps one client or engagement's context separate from every other. This skill manages those workspaces.

## Subcommands

- `/ip-legal:matter-workspace new <slug>` — create a new matter workspace, run a short intake, write `matter.md`
- `/ip-legal:matter-workspace list` — list matters with status and active flag
- `/ip-legal:matter-workspace switch <slug>` — set the active matter
- `/ip-legal:matter-workspace close <slug>` — archive a matter (move to `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/matters/_archived/`, never delete)
- `/ip-legal:matter-workspace none` — detach from any active matter, work at practice-level only

## Instructions

1. Read `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/practice-profile.md` — confirm the `## Matter workspaces` section is populated. If `Enabled` is `✗`, tell the user: "Matter workspaces are off — you're configured as an in-house practice with one client, so the plugin works from practice-level context automatically. If you actually work across multiple clients, re-run `/ip-legal:cold-start-interview --redo` and select a private-practice setting. Otherwise, you don't need `/ip-legal:matter-workspace` at all." Don't error — the disabled state is the expected one for in-house users.
2. Follow the subcommand logic below.
3. Dispatch on the first token of `$ARGUMENTS`:
   - `new` → run the intake interview, write `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/matters/<slug>/matter.md`, seed `history.md` and `notes.md`.
   - `list` → enumerate `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/matters/*/matter.md`, print a table, mark the active matter.
   - `switch` → update the `Active matter:` line in the practice-level practice-profile.md.
   - `close` → move `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/matters/<slug>/` to `~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/matters/_archived/<slug>/`, log the close date in `history.md`.
   - `none` → set `Active matter:` to `none — practice-level context only`.
4. Show the user what changed and confirm before writing.

## Notes

- The skill never reads across matters unless `Cross-matter context` is `on` in the practice-level practice-profile.md.
- Archiving is not deletion — closed matters remain readable for retention/conflicts purposes.
- Slugs are lowercase with hyphens. If a slug is reused across archived and active, the archived one is preserved under `_archived/<slug>/`.

---

Multi-client practitioners (private practice — solo, small firm, large firm) work across many matters. Context from one must not leak into another. This skill is the thin file-management layer that makes that true.

**Default state is off.** In-house users never see this — they run at practice-level only. Matter workspaces turn on at cold-start for private-practice users, or by editing `## Matter workspaces` in the practice-level practice-profile.md. If `Enabled` is `✗`, this skill does not run; instead it explains the disabled state and suggests `/ip-legal:cold-start-interview --redo` for users who actually need matter isolation.

## Storage layout

All matter data lives under:

```
~/.codebuddy/plugins/config/legal-workflows/ip-legal/
├── practice-profile.md                       # practice-level practice profile
└── matters/
    ├── <slug>/
    │   ├── matter.md               # client, counterparty, matter type, key facts, overrides
    │   ├── history.md              # dated log of events, decisions, drafts, reviews
    │   ├── notes.md                # free-form working notes
    │   └── outputs/                # skill outputs for this matter (optional subfolder)
    └── _archived/
        └── <slug>/                 # closed matters — readable but not active
```

Slugs are lowercase with hyphens. Examples: `acme-trademark-2026`, `zenith-dmca`, `novacorp-fto`.

## Active matter is in the practice practice-profile.md

The `Active matter:` line under `## Matter workspaces` in the practice-level practice-profile.md is the single source of truth. Switching a matter edits that line. No separate state file.

## Subcommand logic

### `new <slug>`

1. Confirm slug is not already present in `matters/<slug>/` or `matters/_archived/<slug>/`. If reused, ask the user to pick a different slug.
2. Run the intake interview:
   - **Client** (the party we represent, or the internal business unit if in-house)
   - **Counterparty** (the other side — may be multiple; may be "unknown third-party infringer" for watch-triggered matters)
   - **Matter type** (read the plugin's practice profile for typical categories; for ip-legal: trademark clearance | trademark enforcement | platform takedown | patent FTO | patent infringement | IP clause review | OSS compliance | portfolio maintenance | other)
   - **Confidentiality level** (standard | heightened | clean-team — heightened prompts extra care in cross-matter settings; clean-team common in patent FTO work)
   - **Key facts** (2–5 sentences: what this matter is about, who the stakeholders are, what's at stake)
   - **Matter-specific overrides to the practice posture** (e.g., "client wants aggressive posture for this mark only", "counterparty is a strategic partner — measured tone only", "inventor unavailable — don't surface for interview")
   - **Related matters** (slugs of any connected matters)
3. Write `matters/<slug>/matter.md` using the template below.
4. Seed `matters/<slug>/history.md` with a single "Opened" entry.
5. Create an empty `matters/<slug>/notes.md`.
6. Do **not** auto-switch to the new matter. Ask: "Want to switch to `<slug>` now? (`/ip-legal:matter-workspace switch <slug>`)"

### `list`

Enumerate `matters/*/matter.md`. Read each file's front-matter or first few lines to extract status. Print a table:

| Slug | Client | Matter type | Status | Opened | Active |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Mark the currently-active matter with `*`. Include `_archived/*` under a separate "Archived" heading if any exist.

### `switch <slug>`

1. Confirm `matters/<slug>/matter.md` exists. If not, offer `/ip-legal:matter-workspace new <slug>`.
2. Edit the `Active matter:` line in the practice-level practice-profile.md to `Active matter: <slug>`.
3. Show the user the matter.md summary so they can confirm they're on the right matter.

### `close <slug>`

1. Confirm `matters/<slug>/` exists.
2. Append a "Closed" entry to `matters/<slug>/history.md` with today's date.
3. Move `matters/<slug>/` → `matters/_archived/<slug>/`.
4. If the closed matter was the active matter, set `Active matter:` to `none — practice-level context only`.

### `none`

Set `Active matter:` in the practice-level practice-profile.md to `none — practice-level context only`. Confirm with the user.

## `matter.md` template

```markdown
[WORK-PRODUCT HEADER — per plugin config ## Outputs — differs by role; see `## Who's using this` in the practice-level practice-profile.md]

# Matter: [Client] — [short description]

**Slug:** [slug]
**Opened:** [YYYY-MM-DD]
**Status:** active
**Confidentiality:** [standard / heightened / clean-team]

---

## Parties

**Client:** [name]
**Counterparty:** [name(s)]

## Matter type

[trademark clearance | trademark enforcement | platform takedown | patent FTO | patent infringement | IP clause review | OSS compliance | portfolio maintenance | other — with one-line rationale]

## Key facts

[2–5 sentences. What this matter is about. Who the stakeholders are. What's at stake. What makes it different from the default posture.]

## Matter-specific overrides

*Any deviation from the practice-level posture that applies to this matter and only this matter.*

- [e.g., "Enforcement posture: measured here even though house default is aggressive — counterparty is a key channel partner."]
- [e.g., "Approval for assertion: extra sign-off from marketing required before any letter goes out."]
- [e.g., "Clean-team: matter files not readable even with cross-matter context on."]

## Related matters

- [slug — one line why related]

## Notes on confidentiality

[If heightened or clean-team, describe why. Who may see matter files. Whether cross-matter context is permissible even if globally on.]
```

## `history.md` seed

```markdown
# History: [Client] — [short description]

Append-only event log. Most recent at top.

---

## [YYYY-MM-DD] — Matter opened

Intake completed. Slug: `[slug]`. Status: active.
[Any initial context worth preserving beyond matter.md — e.g., "Opened in response to watch-service hit on `APEXLEAF` in class 25."]
```

## Cross-matter context

The practice-level practice-profile.md has a `Cross-matter context:` flag. When it's `off` (the default), a skill working in matter A **never reads** files in `matters/B/` for any other `B`. Period. This is the confidentiality guarantee the setting exists to provide.

When it's `on`, a skill may read files across matter folders only when the user explicitly asks it to (e.g., "show me every enforcement letter we've sent on this mark across matters"). Even when `on`, the default is to load only the active matter unless the user asks for a cross-matter view.

## What this skill does not do

- **Run a conflicts check.** Conflicts are the practitioner's/firm's job; the intake captures what the user declares.
- **Enforce retention.** Closing archives a matter; it does not delete. Retention policy is out of scope.
- **Auto-route outputs.** The substantive skill decides where to write; this skill tells it *which folder* is active, not what to put in it.
- **Decide whether cross-matter is appropriate.** It reads the flag and obeys.

e3ca42b7e1a970bca8c3cf0fe0b04e83352e9314.text:
# 第八部分　平台差异对照

> 底层逻辑相通，但**具体参数、产品名、口径各平台不同**。这部分是换平台时的速查表。

## 8.1 学习期门槛与稳定期对照

这是最容易混淆的地方——不同平台的门槛本来就不一样，不存在"唯一正确答案"。

| 平台           | 主流出价方式          | 学习期门槛                  | 稳定期   | 特点                                    |
| ------------ | --------------- | ---------------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------- |
| **巨量引擎/头条**  | oCPM            | **20 个转化**（口径：首投 4 天内） | 3-5 天 | 算法最成熟、流量最大、支持转化目标最多。适合日均 3000+ 的效果广告主 |
| **腾讯广告**     | oCPM / oCPC 都支持 | **30 个转化**             | 3-7 天 | 社交流量（微信/QQ），用户画像最精准。适合小程序/社交电商        |
| **百度**       | oCPC            | **30 个转化**             | 5-7 天 | 搜索流量 + 信息流，意图更明确、转化相对精准。适合教育/医疗/B2B   |
| **Meta（海外）** | ——              | **50 个转化**（口径：7 天内）    | ——    | 口径不同，逻辑一致                             |

**选择建议**：预算充足选头条，搜索流量选百度，社交裂变选腾讯。

⚠️ **深度转化目标要放宽**：以上是浅层转化（激活/注册/表单）的门槛。深度转化（付费/次留/ROI）数据稀疏，所需转化数与时间都要相应放宽。**执行时以你实际投放平台的官方口径为准。**

**复制计划也要重新过学习期**——复制走的是配置，模型积累的转化数据留在原计划身上。原计划的预估转化率是几百个真实转化喂出来的，这份"记忆"复制不走。

## 8.2 巨量引擎 / 千川

**产品矩阵**：巨量广告（竞价）、千川（电商直播）、本地推、星图（达人）、穿山甲（联盟）、巨量创意、巨量算数、巨量云图。

### 千川特有的判断

- 千川不能只调广告参数——**商品、价格、库存、直播间承接会实时改变投放结果**
- 千川素材的本质是**用钱买确定性流量**，而不是赌自然流量的运气
- **致命误区**：同一条视频既发主页挂车吃自然流、又投千川烧钱。结果视频内容偏内容向，两头都不讨好
- **正确做法**：两套素材体系、两套考核标准、两套优化逻辑。挂车爆款复制投千川，千川爆款优化后发主页挂车

### 千川素材测试 SOP

**测试前三件事**：

1. **账户权重确认**——新账户先跑 100 单建立模型；老账户检查近 7 日 ROI 是否 ≥ 目标值。权重低时强测 = 烧钱
2. **测试预算分配**——单素材测试预算 = 目标 CPA × 50（CPA 80 元 → 单素材 4000 元），同时测 3-5 条，总预算 1.2-2 万
3. **计划结构**——投放方式：专业推广（精准控量）；出价方式：控成本投放（目标成本 = 1.2 倍预期 CPA）；投放时段：全天或高峰（18:00-23:00）

**72 小时黄金测试周期**：24h 看趋势（CTR）→ 48h 看转化 → 72h 定去留。

**UBMax 自动化投放**：日预算建议 ≥ 目标成本 × 50，给机器足够探索空间；素材丰富度 = 机器优化的上限。

### CID 引流链路（电商投手必懂）

CID 是把广告点击与商品页打通的技术链路，用于站外引流到抖音电商，需配置商品 ID 与监测参数。

## 8.3 腾讯广告（AMS）

**产品矩阵**：ADQ（投放平台）、广点通、优量汇（联盟）。

### 版位与形态

| 版位类型         | 具体形态                                         |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| 微信生态         | 朋友圈广告、公众号/小程序广告、视频号原生广告、搜一搜广告、互选广告、看一看广告     |
| PCAD（腾讯媒体矩阵） | 闪屏、信息流、贴片、蒙层、激励、搜索（覆盖 QQ、QQ 浏览器、腾讯视频、QQ 音乐等） |
| 优量汇          | 开屏、插屏、激励、信息流（域外流量聚合）                         |
| 互动形态         | OneShot、Phonemax、互动闪屏、信息流破框、TVmax            |

**朋友圈广告的用户数据参考**：日均渗透率接近 75%；超 8 成用户看完朋友圈广告后会有行动。

**朋友圈竞价广告特点**：CTR 高、转化高；支持首条评论、支持挂载图文组件、支持一键下载/应用直达、支持直接留企业微信名片。

### 关键操作差异

- ⚠️ **不要把朋友圈和视频号混为同一种流量**——版位合并会掩盖真实问题，必须**拆分版位**排查
- 腾讯 ADQ 视频号有三个入口：原生内容（主页内容拉取）、互动沉淀原视频、直播推广（短视频推直播）
- **ADQ 原生内容赛马**：目标不是买播放，是挑出值得追投的主页内容。做法是 5 条主页内容同题不同钩子（同产品、同利益点，只换前 3 秒和钩子），点击 × 停留 × 组件点击同时过线者胜出，5 选 1 进入原生放大
- 视频号小店智投配置：单账户预算建议 > 5000 元（预算太抠系统没探索空间）；小店管理员扫码确认绑定视频号，最多可批量绑定 20 个

### 企业微信获客链路

腾讯全流量（微信广告、腾讯平台与内容广告、优量汇）均支持企业微信获客：

- **直跳链路**：各流量版位直跳企业微信名片，高效获客
- **筛客链路**：通过落地页组件、公众号关注等二跳加微，高效筛客

## 8.4 小红书（聚光 / 薯条）

### 聚光 vs 薯条：流量基因完全不同

|      | **聚光（收割型）**                   | **薯条（种草型）**  |
| ---- | ----------------------------- | ------------ |
| 用户来源 | 搜索关键词、笔记评论区、商品详情页             | 发现页信息流、关注页推荐 |
| 心智状态 | 已被种草，正在比价决策                   | 闲逛状态，等待内容破防  |
| 核心特征 | 主动寻找                          | 被动触达，冲动决策    |
| 真相   | **聚光的流量不是"推"出来的，是用户自己"找"过来的** | 规模种草         |
|      |                               |              |
|      |                               |              |
|      |                               |              |

### 出价方式

| 方式          | 特点                                  | 适用                    |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| oCPC（推荐）    | 转化成本可控，±20% 波动范围。**成本超 20% 平台赔付差价** | 有明确转化目标、预算适中、追求稳定 ROI |
| Nobid（新手友好） | 只设预算不设出价，系统智能托管，预算内最大化转化数           | 预算明确、缺少成本概念           |

### 平台特性与限制

- ⚠️ **聚光不是纯竞价问题**——笔记内容价值、社区语境、搜索意图会直接影响分发
- 低质广告即使出价高也会被降权
- 原生品牌笔记 eCPM 权重更高
- 平台重视社区氛围保护
- **信息流与搜索需分别起量**，不能混在一起看
- KOS（企业号+员工号矩阵）：多账号消息聚合管理，客资来源清晰归类

## 8.5 快手（磁力引擎）

- **产品**：磁力引擎（投放平台）、磁力金牛（电商）、快分销
- ⚠️ **磁力流量对社区表达和素材标签敏感**，生硬搬运其他平台素材容易匹配错误人群
- **素材方向**：强人设口播、真实场景、直播切片、"老铁"信任表达
- **排查入口**：磁力引擎投放诊断与转化追踪
- **转化链路**：表单、私信、加粉、店铺、直播间

## 8.6 百度营销

- **产品**：百度推广、基木鱼（落地页）、观星盘（数据）、爱番番（CRM）
- **核心特性**：搜索 + 信息流双场景，意图更明确
- ⚠️ **关键词与搜索词不是一回事**——只看关键词汇总会隐藏低意图流量，必须看搜索词报告
- **搜索广告 vs 信息流的核心差异**：搜索广告调整后**立即生效**，没有"频繁调价重置学习期"的问题；信息流则必须给算法时间和数据
- 需按意图和匹配方式拆分单元

## 8.7 各平台通用差异速查

| 维度    | 巨量引擎         | 腾讯广告      | 小红书        | 快手      | 百度       |
| ----- | ------------ | --------- | ---------- | ------- | -------- |
| 主流出价  | oCPM         | oCPM/oCPC | oCPC/Nobid | oCPM    | oCPC     |
| 学习期门槛 | 20 个转化       | 30 个转化    | ——         | ——      | 30 个转化   |
| 稳定期   | 3-5 天        | 3-7 天     | ——         | ——      | 5-7 天    |
| 流量特性  | 量最大、算法最成熟    | 社交画像最精准   | 搜索意图 + 种草  | 社区信任、下沉 | 搜索意图最明确  |
| 素材关键  | 首帧 + 前 3 秒留存 | 原生感、版位适配  | 笔记内容价值     | 强人设口播   | 关键词相关性   |
| 特别注意  | 千川需同步管货盘     | 版位必须拆开看   | 内容质量影响分发   | 不能搬运素材  | 看搜索词非关键词 |

# 交易结构风险分析（子流程C）

> 来源：《股权投融资：风险防范及争议解决》第4章
> 方法论ID：V07（股债定性四维分析框架）+ V08（名股实债四步防范法）
> 更新：以担保制度解释（2021.1.1）+ 新公司法（2024.7.1）为基准

---

## 一、股债定性四维分析框架（V07）

当投资性质（股权vs债权）发生争议时，法院从四个维度综合判断——**不依赖单一因素，四维加权后综合定性**。

### 维度一：缔约磋商过程

| 指向"债"的信号 | 指向"股"的信号 |
|---|---|
| 签约前有借款申请/还款计划 | 签约前讨论估值/董事会席位 |
| 目标公司出具了股东会借款决议 | 讨论的是增资/股权转让方案 |
| 各方沟通中反复出现"融资""借款""还本付息" | 各方沟通中使用"投资""入股""估值""股权比例" |

### 维度二：转让价格

| 指向"债"的信号 | 指向"股"的信号 |
|---|---|
| 转让价格明显偏离股权实际价值（如1元受让90%股权） | 转让价格与公司估值匹配 |
| 转让价格与注册资本金/净资产无关 | 转让价格基于估值且经协商 |

**典型案例**：重庆高院(2014)渝高法民初字第00010号——信托公司以1元受让90%股权，"与该股权的实际市场价值不符，也不符合常理"。

### 维度三：收益安排与经营管理权

| 指向"债"的信号 | 指向"股"的信号 |
|---|---|
| 固定回报率，不与企业业绩挂钩 | 回报与经营业绩挂钩 |
| 投资人不参与公司经营管理 | 投资人委派董事/参与重大决策 |
| 不享有/不主张表决权 | 实际行使表决权 |
| 约定到期无条件回购 | 退出路径与公司业绩/IPO等条件联动 |

### 维度四：担保机制

| 指向"债"的信号 | 指向"股"的信号 |
|---|---|
| 设置了抵押/质押/保证等债权类担保 | 无担保措施 |
| 第三方（创始人/实控人）提供连带保证 | 仅有投资文件中的陈述与保证 |

**典型案例**：重庆高院(2014)渝高法民初字第00045号——"将《合作协议》认定为股权转让协议与当事人办理相关抵押、质押担保的意思表示不符"。

### 辅助工具：意思表示解释五方法（民法典第142条）

```
词句 → 相关条款 → 行为性质和目的 → 交易习惯 → 诚实信用原则
```

### [重要] 重要规则：内外有别

- **内部关系**（当事人之间）：适用"实质重于形式"，以四维分析探明真实意思
- **外部关系**（涉及第三人，尤其破产时）：适用"外观主义"，以工商登记为准
  - 湖州港城置业案：信托机构被登记为80%股东→破产程序中不被认定为债权人
  - 最高院(2018)最高法民终785号：明确区分内外关系，对内实质重于形式、对外外观主义

---

## 二、名股实债四步防范法（V08）

### 第一步：资金融出方式选择

| 方式 | 破产场景下债权保护 | 操作要点 |
|---|---|---|
| 直接支付股权转让款 | [弱] 投资人被登记为股东，破产时可能无法以债权人身份申报 | 须区分内部/外部关系 |
| 收购股权/项目收益权 | [中等] 不具有股东身份，破产时申报债权障碍较小 | 增信措施较受让股权弱 |
| 股东借款（先成为股东再借款） | [较强] 现有法律未限制股东申报债权（如股东借款） | 注意出资不实股东的衡平居次风险 |

**衡平居次风险**（深石原则）：出资不实的股东在补足出资后，其债权可能与外部债权人不同等受偿顺位。

### 第二步：本金收回路径设计

| 回购义务人 | 效力 | 实操难点 |
|---|---|---|
| 目标公司 | [受限] 受资本维持原则严格限制，须完成减资程序 | [重要] 新公司法第224条第3款：定向减资（不等比减资）须经全体股东另有约定或章程另有规定，默认须等比减资 |
| 创始股东/实控人 | [无争议] 效力最无争议 | 须评估创始股东个人偿付能力 |
| 第三方（非股东） | [需注意] 须解决通知其他股东+优先购买权问题 | 可加入一位现有股东作为共同行动人 |

> **重大更新**：新公司法第224条第3款规定定向减资（不等比减资）须经全体股东另有约定或章程另有规定（旧法仅需2/3，默认须等比减资）。这意味着只要有一个小股东反对且未另有约定，目标公司回购路径就会被堵死。**建议优先选择"创始股东回购+目标公司连带担保"模式**。

### 第三步：固定投资回报率风险

企业间借贷合同有效的三个要件（来自《审理民间借贷案件规定》）：
1. 资金用途为生产经营
2. 资金来源为出借企业自有资金
3. 借贷行为是**临时性**资金拆借，出借企业**不以经常性放贷为业**

[重要] 若约定固定回报且投资行为具有反复性/经常性/营业性→可能被认定为未经许可从事金融业务→合同无效→虽可收回本金但损失部分回报。

### 第四步：增信措施叠加

建议同时设置以下多层增信（按重要性排序）：
1. **创始股东/实控人连带责任保证** ← 最核心
2. **股权质押**（投资人持有的目标公司股权质押给出借方）
3. **在建工程/不动产抵押**（如有重大资产）
4. **反稀释条款**
5. **参与公司治理**（委派董事/财务监督权/一票否决权）
6. **资金使用监管**（共管账户/用途限制/定期报告）

---

## 综合风险分析输出模板

```markdown

| 转让价格 | [事实描述] | 股/债/中性 |
| 收益安排与经营参与 | [事实描述] | 股/债/中性 |
| 担保机制 | [事实描述] | 股/债/中性 |
| **综合倾向** | — | **股/债/混合** |
| **置信度** | — | **高/中/低**（标注不确定性来源） |

### 二、名股实债四步防范

| 步骤 | 现状 | 建议 | 风险等级 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 资金融出方式 | [现状] | [建议] | [等级] |
| 本金收回路径 | [现状] | [建议] | [等级] |

| 增信措施 | [现状] | [建议] | [等级] |

### 三、法律依据（时效标注）

```

## 来源追溯

- 书本章节：第4章全章（第103-118页）
- 书中方法论：股债定性四维分析 + 名股实债四步防范法
- 关键更新：
  - 担保制度解释第68/69条（2021.1.1）：让与担保正式入法、名义股东出资责任豁免
  - 新公司法第224条第3款：定向减资（不等比减资）须经全体股东另有约定或章程另有规定，默认须等比减资
  - 裁判趋势：从"以认定股权投资为主"翻转为"以认定债权投资（让与担保）为主"
- 典型案例：
  - (2014)渝高法民初字第00010号：四维分析认定股权转让实为借款合同
  - (2016)浙0502民初1671号（湖州港城置业案）：破产中外外观主义优先
  - (2018)最高法民终785号：明确内外有别规则
- 作者盲点：未能预见担保解释后裁判倾向的根本性翻转（从"股"→"债"），书中对名股实债的风险持较为悲观态度，而新规则下投资人的债权保护实际上有所增强

# Weekly FBA Inventory Plan — Output Guide

Use this structure when delivering a weekly (or ad-hoc) restock plan to ops / finance.

## 1. Executive Summary (top of report)

- Marketplace(s) covered
- SKU count reviewed / action count (restock / hold / remove)
- Total recommended inbound units
- Total cash required for recommended shipments
- Top risks: stockout SKUs, aged-threshold SKUs, utilization pressure

## 2. SKU-Level Plan Table

Fill one row per FNSKU (preferred) or ASIN.  
CSV template: `assets/weekly-plan-template.csv`

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| marketplace | e.g. US, UK, DE, JP |
| sku / fnsku / asin / title | Identity |
| forecast_daily | Planning demand rate \( \hat{D} \) |
| forecast_method | ma / ewma / seasonal_index / poisson_gamma / bayes-es / etc. |
| std_demand | Uncertainty passed into safety stock |
| service_level | Target service level used |
| current_sellable | FBA sellable on hand |
| inbound | Units already inbound |
| days_of_cover | current_sellable ÷ forecast_daily (or +inbound if you define that way — state it) |
| lead_time_days | PO → sellable |
| target_cover_days | Policy cover target for this SKU/phase |
| recommended_qty | Total units to ship this cycle (after MOQ/multiple) |
| destination | FBA / AWD / HUB / SPLIT |
| qty_fba | Units bound for FBA |
| qty_upstream | Units to AWD or local/overseas hub |
| fba_cover_target_days | FBA node policy cover used for split |
| suggested_inbound_week | Target arrival week |
| age_bucket_days | Representative inventory age (or oldest meaningful band) |
| aged_threshold_days | Marketplace threshold (181 US, 241 UK/EU, …) |
| age_risk | OK / WATCH / CRITICAL |
| hold_vs_remove | n/a / HOLD / REMOVE (from hold_vs_remove.py when near threshold) |
| ads_status | OFF / LOW / ON / HIGH |
| cover_class | LOW / OK / HIGH |
| ads_inventory_pattern | A / B / C / D / n/a |
| ads_action_note | Planner note for ads coordination |
| unit_cost | Cost incl. inbound freight |
| net_price | Net proceeds after Amazon fees |
| cash_impact | recommended_qty × unit_cost |
| holding_cost_est | H(Q) if computed |
| unsold_loss_est | L(Q) if computed |
| expected_net_profit | π(Q) if computed |
| priority | A / B / C (velocity & strategic importance) |
| notes | Phase, promo, supplier constraint, etc. |

## 3. Recommended Section Order in a Written Plan

1. **Stockout risk (Priority A, low cover)** — ship first  
2. **Aged / near-threshold** — HOLD vs REMOVE decisions  
3. **Normal restock** — remaining positive recommended_qty  
4. **No action** — healthy cover, no age risk  
5. **Cash & capacity summary** — total cash, optional split-inbound proposal  

## 4. Urgency Ranking Rule (default)

1. Stockout risk (days of cover below policy minimum)  
2. Aged risk (WATCH / CRITICAL)  
3. Normal restock by forecast velocity / margin  
4. Dead stock clearance (REMOVE) as a separate workstream  

## 5. Example One-Line SKU Conclusion

> **SKU-FAN-01 (US)** — Forecast 93/day (seasonal). Cover 23d. Recommend **4,330 units** to arrive W18. Cash ~$77.9k. Age OK. Priority A. Pre-peak build for Jun–Aug.

## 6. Tooling Chain (inside this skill)

```
forecast_demand.py / forecast_bayesian.py / seasonal_index.py
        → daily_sales, std_demand
calculate_restock.py
        → recommended_qty, H(Q), L(Q), profit
multi-warehouse rules (references/multi-warehouse.md)
        → destination, qty_fba, qty_upstream
hold_vs_remove.py   (when near aged threshold)
        → HOLD / REMOVE
Fill weekly-plan-template.csv → deliver
```

## 7. Notes for Planners

- Always state assumptions (forecast method, sell-through, lead time).
- For seasonal SKUs, state which phase target cover was used.
- Cash impact is purchase cash, not Amazon remittance timing.
- Split large recommended_qty when payment terms / cash peak require it (see storage-optimization.md).

e3e4ed49d2df77a32c4beb3e0c74c788fadc7aee.text:
# Multi-Channel Shared Inventory (海外仓 / 本地仓 / 多平台)

Extends FBA-centric planning to a **shared inventory network**: local warehouse, overseas 3PL, and non-Amazon channels (Shopify, TikTok Shop, eBay, Walmart, wholesale, etc.).

Industry consensus (2025–2026 ops practice): one physical truth, channel-specific **visibility**, hard rules against oversell — especially when Amazon is in the mix.

## 1. Core Architecture

```
Physical stock (WMS / 3PL / local / overseas)
        ↓
  Free-to-sell (ATP) pool
        ↓
  ┌─────┴──────────────────────┐
  │                            │
Static ring-fence            Shared pool
(FBA send-in)            (MFN + DTC + other marketplaces)
  │                            │
FBA only              Channel caps + buffers + reserves
```

**Critical fact:** Units already in **FBA are not poolable** with other channels (unless using MCF at extra cost).  
Treat FBA as a **static allocation**. Everything else can share one pool if sync is fast enough.

## 2. Available-to-Promise (ATP) Formula

Do not publish “on-hand” to channels. Publish ATP:

```
ATP = On-hand
    − Committed orders (unshipped)
    − Quality / returns hold
    − Wholesale / promo / pre-order reserves
    − FBA-dedicated & FBA in-transit
    − Central safety buffer (optional)
```

Only **ATP** feeds channel availability rules.

## 3. Pooling Models (choose by sync speed)

| Sync latency | Safe model | Oversell risk |
|--------------|------------|---------------|
| Manual / hours–days | **Static split only** (fixed units per channel) | High if forced unified |
| 15–60 min | Dynamic allocation + larger buffers | Moderate |
| 2–15 min | Unified pool + small buffers | Low |
| < 2 min (event-driven) | Full unified pool | Minimal |

**Hybrid (most Amazon+DTC sellers):**  
- Static quantity for FBA  
- Unified pool for Shopify / TikTok / eBay / MFN / wholesale remainder  

## 4. Channel Buffers (anti-oversell)

Never list 100% of ATP on every channel. Hold back a buffer for sync lag and spikes.

| Channel | Typical buffer | Why |
|---------|----------------|-----|
| Amazon (MFN) | 10–15% | Oversell → ODR / suspension risk |
| Walmart | 10–15% | Similar marketplace penalties |
| TikTok Shop | 15–20% | Faster spikes, API maturity varies |
| Shopify DTC | 5–10% | Lower platform penalty; higher margin |
| eBay | ~10% | Mid |

**Velocity-based buffer (optional):**

```
Buffer ≈ daily_velocity × (sync_interval_hours / 24) × 1.5~2.0
```

## 5. Channel Priority When Stock Is Scarce

When ATP is low, do not first-come-first-served blindly. Prefer:

1. **Hard reserves** (confirmed wholesale PO, pre-orders, promo holds)  
2. **Highest contribution margin** after fees  
3. **Strategic / rank-critical** Amazon ASINs (if MFN)  
4. Lower-margin marketplaces last  

Example priority stack (illustrative): DTC → Wholesale committed → Amazon MFN → other marketplaces.

## 6. FBA vs Shared Pool Planning

| Decision | Rule |
|----------|------|
| How much to send to FBA | Use **Amazon-only forecast** + FBA LT + FBA safety stock (existing skill modules) |
| What remains for other channels | Total purchasable − FBA allocation − FBA pipeline |
| Over-ship to FBA | Double penalty: FBA storage/aged fees **and** starvation of other channels |
| Amazon restock report | Often ignores other channels — **do not** follow blindly for shared SKUs |

## 7. Overseas / Local Warehouse Roles

| Node | Shared-pool role |
|------|------------------|
| **Overseas 3PL (美/欧仓等)** | Primary shared pool for MFN + multi-platform fulfillment |
| **Local / origin warehouse** | Bulk hold, prep, first-leg to overseas or FBA |
| **FBA** | Ring-fenced sellable for Amazon Prime path |
| **AWD** | Amazon-side upstream (not multi-platform pool) |

Allocation idea for overseas hub stock:

```
Hub_ATP → apply channel buffers → publish per channel
Hub → FBA transfer = separate decision (multi-warehouse rules)
```

## 8. Replenishment of the Shared Pool

Forecast **total multi-channel demand** for hub replenishment:

```
D_shared = Σ channel daily demand (exclude pure FBA-fulfilled volume)
ROP_shared = D_shared × LT_to_hub + SS_shared
```

Then split arrivals:

- Portion to FBA (Amazon plan)  
- Remainder to hub ATP pool  

Do **not** sum independent channel safety stocks if they share one warehouse — that double-counts buffer and ties up cash. Prefer **one pool SS** + channel publish buffers.

## 9. Reserves (must subtract from ATP)

- Wholesale standing orders  
- Pre-orders  
- Campaign / flash-sale holds  
- Quality inspection / quarantine  
- Bundle component locks  

Review reserves weekly; stale reserves recreate silos.

## 10. Planner Workflow (add-on to weekly plan)

1. Start from WMS on-hand by location  
2. Compute ATP (formula above)  
3. Decide FBA send-in with existing FBA modules  
4. Remaining ATP → shared pool  
5. Apply channel buffers + priority / caps  
6. Set publish qty per channel  
7. Flag sync health (if lag high → raise buffers or freeze risky channels)  

## 11. Weekly Plan Fields (optional columns)

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| location | FBA / AWD / OVERSEAS_HUB / LOCAL |
| atp_units | Free-to-sell after holds |
| pool_type | STATIC_FBA / SHARED |
| channel_publish_amazon_mfn | Qty visible on Amazon MFN |
| channel_publish_dtc | Qty visible on DTC |
| channel_buffer_pct | Buffer used |
| shared_priority | Channel rank when scarce |

## 12. Principles

1. **One physical truth** — WMS/ERP is source of truth, not Seller Central alone.  
2. **FBA is ring-fenced** — plan it separately; never assume it can back DTC.  
3. **Publish ATP, not on-hand.**  
4. **Buffers scale with lag and penalty severity.**  
5. **Replenish the pool from combined demand; allocate FBA from Amazon demand.**  
6. **Oversell prevention > maximizing every channel’s displayed stock.**

## Link to Existing Modules

| Module | Interaction |
|--------|-------------|
| multi-warehouse.md | FBA/AWD/hub node choice for Amazon path |
| demand-forecasting.md | Channel-level inputs; sum for shared ROP |
| safety-stock.md | Pool-level SS for hub; FBA SS stays Amazon-specific |
| supplier-constraints.md | MOQ applies to factory→hub or factory→FBA legs |
| exception-priority.md | Add oversell/sync failures as data-quality or pipeline exceptions |
| ads-inventory-linkage.md | Do not spike ads on a channel whose publish qty is buffer-throttled |

# Prospecting Compliance Reference

The legal and platform-ToS constraints that apply to prospect list building. Read first, every engagement.

> Operational guidance, not legal advice. For high-volume programs or programs touching EU/UK residents, run your setup past a privacy attorney.

---

## United States — CAN-SPAM (downstream)

CAN-SPAM regulates the cold email **send**, not the list build. But the list build matters because:

- You must be able to identify the source of every email address you contact (required if challenged)
- The "from" line and email content rules apply at send time — but you can't lie about how you got the contact
- Opt-out requests must be honored within 10 business days and tracked

**For prospecting specifically**: capture and retain the source URL + date for every contact you add to a list. CAN-SPAM doesn't require it explicitly, but defending your sender practices does.

---

## EU / UK — GDPR

The strictest applicable framework. Triggers when:

- Your prospect resides in EU/UK
- You're processing personal data (any identifiable info, including business emails tied to a named person)

### Lawful bases for cold B2B outreach

You have three credible options:

1. **Legitimate interest** (most common for B2B). Requires:
   - The contact is in a business role likely to be interested in your offer
   - The data was collected from a public, business-context source
   - You provide a clear opt-out
   - You can articulate the legitimate interest test in writing

2. **Consent** — typically not feasible for cold outreach (you don't have consent before first contact)

3. **Existing customer relationship** — only applies to current customers, not prospects

### What you must do

- Capture **source + date + lawful basis** for every contact
- Honor data subject access requests (DSARs) — you must be able to disclose, correct, or delete on request
- Include a privacy notice / opt-out in the first outreach
- Don't store personal data longer than necessary for the legitimate interest

### What disqualifies a list

- Bulk-scraped LinkedIn data — explicit ToS violation + GDPR risk
- Email addresses purchased from a list broker without source provenance
- "Anyone @ this domain" guessed emails sent without verification (multiplies risk + bounces)

---

## Canada — CASL

Stricter than CAN-SPAM. Cold B2B outreach requires:

- **Express consent** (explicit opt-in) — typically not present for cold prospecting
- **OR implied consent** — existing business relationship within 24 months, OR business address publicly published on the company's own site for the purpose of receiving such communications

**Practical implication for Canadian prospects**: relying on the publicly-published-address exception is the most defensible cold prospecting basis in Canada. You must include sender identification, mailing address, and an unsubscribe mechanism in every message.

---

## Platform Terms of Service

### LinkedIn

- **Sales Navigator** as a research tool: fine
- **Scraping LinkedIn at any scale**: explicit ToS violation. Banned accounts are permanent. Don't.
- **Apollo, Clay, and ZoomInfo** claim LinkedIn-overlap data through various legitimate channels — verify their data sources before assuming compliance
- **InMail and Connection Requests**: governed by LinkedIn's own messaging rules, not by CAN-SPAM/GDPR (because LinkedIn-internal)

### Google Maps

- ToS prohibits bulk extraction or productizing Maps data
- Browser-assisted research as a discovery aid: acceptable
- Storing Place IDs or large structured Maps data in your CRM: explicit ToS prohibition
- Use Maps to **find** local businesses, then cross-source from the business's own site for the data you retain

### Apollo / ZoomInfo / Clearbit

- All have their own ToS limiting reselling, downstream sharing, and use cases
- Read your contract — typically you can use the data for your own outreach but not productize it
- Don't share extracts publicly (e.g., on a leaderboard, in a public report)

### Crunchbase

- Free tier is read-only for personal use
- Paid tier permits broader use within contractual scope
- API access requires paid Pro+ tier

---

## Anti-Patterns (Don't Do These)

1. **Bulk-scraping LinkedIn / Google Maps / Yelp**. Browser-assisted research is OK; automated scrapers pointed at these platforms are not. **Firecrawl and Browserbase are fine for an individual prospect's own website** (the URL you found through manual discovery) — not for the platforms hosting prospects.
2. **Buying lists from random vendors** without source provenance. You inherit their legal exposure.
3. **Guessing emails and sending unverified**. Bounce rates over 2% destroy sender reputation; legally, you can't claim a "legitimate interest" basis for an email you fabricated.
4. **Harvesting personal email addresses** (Gmail, personal Outlook, etc.) from public profiles. Personal addresses raise GDPR risk significantly.
5. **Storing data you don't need**. Minimize retention. Don't keep prospect lists forever — GDPR right to deletion applies.
6. **Skipping the lawful basis documentation**. If challenged, you need to show your work. Capture source URL + collection date for every contact.
7. **Reselling prospect lists**. You may not have the right to share them downstream. Read your data provider contracts.
8. **CAPTCHA bypass / login wall bypass**. Even if technically possible, this signals bot behavior and violates virtually every ToS.

---

## Quick Audit Checklist

Before shipping a list to the user (or downstream to cold-email):

- [ ] Every contact has a source URL + collection date
- [ ] No contacts sourced from scraped LinkedIn data
- [ ] No Google Maps Place IDs or large Maps-structured data retained
- [ ] Lawful basis documented (legitimate interest test for B2B, or relevant alternative)
- [ ] Email addresses validated (deliverability check before outreach)
- [ ] Personal addresses (Gmail, etc.) flagged or excluded
- [ ] Source provider contracts permit the intended use case
- [ ] Retention plan documented (when to delete)
- [ ] First outreach will include unsubscribe + privacy notice (downstream concern for cold-email skill, but mention it now)
